documents: Refunds for a delivered product must be requested within thirty days of delivery. Return postage is paid by the customer.
Orders cancelled before dispatch receive an automatic refund within five working days. No parcel needs to be returned.
Duplicate card charges are reversed by billing after verifying the two transaction identifiers. Do not cancel the customer's order.
Unrecognized card purchases require a fraud investigation. Freeze the payment method and escalate; never promise an immediate refund.
Password reset: send a reset link to the verified email. The link expires after fifteen minutes. Never ask for the existing password.
A locked account needs identity verification before support removes the lock. Resetting a password alone will not remove the lock.
Lost two-factor device: use a recovery code or complete identity verification. Support must never disable verification based only on a phone request.
Late delivery: check the tracking status and open a carrier investigation after seven days without an update.
A parcel marked delivered but not received needs proof of delivery and an address check before a carrier claim is opened.
Damaged item: request photographs of the damage and packaging. Offer replacement after validating the claim; do not use the late delivery procedure.
Changing a delivery address is possible only before dispatch. After dispatch, contact the carrier for possible redirection.
Subscription cancellation stops the next renewal but does not automatically refund the current subscription period.
